editorial_policy.sensationalism: engaging presentation only; no exaggerated, communal, caste-based or unverified claims

stories.headline: Roadways bus fire; 55 passengers escaped
stories.claim: A Delhi–Bareilly roadways bus caught fire near Dalpatpur overbridge on 4 Nov night; all 55 passengers escaped. Tyre-burst cause is only the Chief Fire Officer's preliminary explanation.

stories.headline: Pre-Diwali FSDA sweet-shop inspections
stories.claim: UP FSDA reported 1,133 inspections, 935 samples, 54 quintals seized and 27 licences suspended; local observations are not all final lab-confirmed adulteration.

stories.headline: ₹99,000 reported cyber fraud during order cancellation
stories.claim: A complainant reports losing about ₹99,000 after following a purported customer-care QR-code process; no platform breach or company involvement is established.

stories.headline: Traders expect about ₹100 crore Dhanteras business
stories.claim: Local traders told Amar Ujala they expect about ₹100 crore in Dhanteras sales across jewellery, vehicles, clothing and electronics; this is a forecast, not audited turnover.

stories.headline: FSSAI household iodine test detects starch in paneer
stories.claim: The prescribed boil-cool-iodine test turns blue when starch is present in paneer; it does not detect every adulterant or certify overall safety.

stories.headline: Food inflation and weak winter planting
stories.claim: September food inflation was 7.74%; weak soil moisture may pressure winter sowing and supplies. These are not current local retail prices.

stories.place: Delhi-NCR including Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar
stories.headline: CAQM construction curbs and up-to-50% physical office attendance
stories.claim: From 5–20 Nov, dust-generating demolition/outdoor construction is restricted across NCR with listed exemptions. Up to 50% physical attendance applies to offices in Delhi and five named districts including Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar.

stories.headline: Supreme Court sends Maharashtra two-child disqualification challenge to larger bench
stories.claim: The Court questioned the contemporary basis of the Maharashtra local-body two-child disqualification and referred the challenge to a larger bench; no blanket nationwide or UP rule has been struck down.

stories.headline: Gold demand down 29% in Q3 ahead of Dhanteras
stories.claim: WGC says Q3 Indian gold demand fell 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tonnes; 625–675 tonnes is a forecast, not final full-year data. Dhanteras is 6 Nov.

stories.headline: FSSAI and energy-drink makers in labelling dispute; hearing listed today
stories.claim: FSSAI says the 'energy drink' descriptor is misleading; companies challenge the process. Earlier interim relief allowed some existing stock but not new stock under that descriptor. No 5 Nov order was located by 07:24 IST.

stories.headline: CERT-In warns financial institutions of AI-assisted CRAFTY FALCON campaign
stories.claim: CERT-In describes AI-assisted attacks against financial institutions and payment APIs; it does not say all retail bank customers are compromised.

stories.headline: India beat New Zealand in first ODI
stories.claim: India won by five wickets under DLS; New Zealand 185 all out, India 143/5 in 22.4 overs; Kohli 74 off 51.

stories.headline: Ramayana Part 1 releases today after large advance bookings
stories.claim: The film releases on 5 Nov. Indian Express reported an advance-booking estimate above ₹110 crore including blocked seats as of 4 Nov evening; excluding blocked seats the estimate was about ₹88 crore. This is pre-sales, not realised box-office revenue.
